lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Sr4Mg2Ti2O12 (reduced formula Sr2MgTiO6) crystallizes in orthorhombic symmetry with space group Amm2 (No. 38) and contains 20 atoms per unit cell across 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral TiO6 and SrO6 environments, with Mg also coordinated by six O neighbors; oxygen centers show three- or four-neighbor geometries. Corner-sharing is observed between Mg–Ti, Mg–Sr, and Sr–Ti octahedral polyhedra, while Ti–Ti octahedra additionally exhibit edge-sharing. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
